title: The Hollow Sigil
author: August Iversen
blurb: Oscar Winterbourne, a debt-bound temple scribe, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. But when a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown before the moon completes its thirteenth turn.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
